title: Crew Rover Down
text: The crew rover is down. The medevac pod fired before the hull split: {first} is alive, strapped in, and on a long, rough ride home.

lines.text: "I'm fine. I'm not fine. I'll be fine. Finish it without me, and don't you dare go easy because I'm not watching."

choices.label: "We'll finish it."
choices.reply: The pod's beacon tracks home across the map. You keep one eye on it the whole time.

choices.label: "I should have kept you back."
choices.reply: "You'd have had to tie me down." A pause. "Next time, tie me down a bit."

notes: The Crew Rover (unit envoy, lostFlag crew-hurt) destroyed on an expedition. Any region; crew-home follows at Touchdown.
